notes.title: The Gap Patch #2
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES:

 Added an accesibility option to toggle Focus and Return instead of holding the button
 Improved level switching on slow machines
 Various smaller gameplay and visual bug fixes

notes.title: The first patch is up!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, the first patch for The Gap is here! 

First and foremost - we've got the coveted green checkmark and we're now officially SteamDeck Verified!

Below is the full list of changes: 

 The Gap is now Steam Deck verified!
 Added Polish localization. Cześć!
 Typo/localization fixes
 Added VSync and more max frame rate options
 Fixed bugs when reentering solved memories
 Made the trigger for quantum computer thoughts larger
 Fixed Blake dialogue playing when selecting the wrong part
 Various visual tweaks
 Fixed a few reflection bugs with Raytracing enabled
 Various smaller bug fixes


Thanks to everyone that reported the bugs, and if you find anything new you can post it on our Community page or on our Discord.

notes.title: The gameplay trailer and release date are OUT
notes.notes:
Just a while ago we've gotten the chance to reveal our trailer at the Future Games Show and we were oh so happy, seeing the live chat's reaction to our game. It's exciting!
The release date is set to the 19th of October - that's just two months away from now! (We even have preorders for Xbox and PlayStation!)

[previewyoutube=wwmHUupHSMY;full][/previewyoutube]

We've been having an amazing time so if you want to join us on the journey of finally releasing this passion project - follow us on Twitter for updates!
